name: YUNSUNG F&C Co.,Ltd
summary: Established in 1986, YUNSUNG F&C Co.,Ltd, with its headquarters located in Anseong, South Korea, provides comprehensive services encompassing the design, engineering, procurement, production, and installation of various equipment and materials. The company also undertakes electrical and piping works, alongside developing automatic control systems. Their product range includes specialized systems for the biopharmaceutical sector, cleaning-in-place (CIP) solutions, and biowaste effluent treatment facilities. Furthermore, they manufacture storage tanks and P/D mixers for the secondary battery industry, as well as diverse equipment for the food industry.
